notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it that has the creature type chosen with Kindred Boon.
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {W}.
description:
Activate Kindred Boon by paying {1}{W}, putting a divinity counter on any creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate that creature using Myojin of Seeing Winds's ability by removing a divinity counter from it, causing you to draw a card for each permanent you control.
Activate two mana-producing permanents by tapping them, adding at least {1}{W}.
Activate Mind over Matter twice by discarding two cards, untapping the mana-producing permanents.
Repeat.
